title: Auto Transfer:Phone To Sd Card
summary: Transfer to SD card automatically and manage USB & OTG storage
description:
Running out of phone storage?

Auto Transfer: Phone To SD Card helps you automatically transfer files between internal storage and SD cards. You can also manually transfer files between phone storage, SD cards, USB OTG devices, and supported pen drives. Move files automatically, organize storage, and manage multiple storage locations from one place.

Move photos, videos, audio files, documents, and APK files automatically. Free up storage space and keep your files organized with less manual work.

✨ Manage phone storage, SD cards, external storage, and USB OTG devices from one easy-to-use file management app.

🔐 PERMISSIONS USED
━━━━━━━━━━━

To provide file transfer and storage management features, the app may request:

• Storage Access – required to view, manage, move, copy, and organize files across device storage

• Media Access – required to access supported media files for transfer and management

• Foreground Service – allows transfers and scheduled operations to continue with a visible notification

All permissions are used only for app functionality.

Users select the source and destination folders used for file transfers.

File transfers depend on available storage space, selected folders, device support, and granted permissions.

Some features may vary depending on Android version, storage type, SD card support, and connected devices.
